meaning:
παρα-δειγματίζω
(δείκνυμι), [in LXX: Num.25:4 (יָקַע hi.), Jer.13:22 (חָמַס ni.), Eze.28:17 (רַאֲוָה), Est.4:17, Dan LXX 2:5 * ;]
to set forth as an example; in bad sense, to put to open shame: Heb.6:6 (Polyb., Plut., al.).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: and then fell away, it is impossible to renew them again to repentance; seeing they crucify the Son of God for themselves again, and put him to open shame.
